caption: The drawing depicts the entrance of a brick building. The main feature is a set of seven brown steps with two black, ornate iron railings on either side, each mounted on a rectangular stone base. At the top of the steps, there is a wooden door, painted a pale gray or white color and featuring four rectangular panels. The door is framed by decorative columns and topped with an elaborate entablature that includes intricate molding and a transom window with geometric patterns. The building facade is constructed of small, reddish-pink bricks, and there are two rectangular, brown window moldings above the door and nearby window, each surrounded by a lighter trim. To the right of the door, there is a large window with a multipane structure, partially covered by sheer, green-and-white striped curtains tied back at the sides. Beneath this window is a small section of black wrought iron railing. The sidewalk and area in front of the steps are colored in light beige. The overall composition centers on the doorway and steps, with the architectural details and window providing additional elements.
title: Entrance to Cutting House
